verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas is documented as a browser engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU that runs in any browser on any device. It automatically falls back from WebGPU to WebGL based on browser support, and community users call it lightweight and a sensible WebGPU-for-web choice. Missing for 10: concrete payload/bundle-size figures (lightness rests only on anecdotal community remarks), and details on how mature WebGPU is or which features it covers.
